submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I tested the densely sampled V-rich region (idx 19: Cu0.10 Fe0.105 V0.79 → 14.7 µA), a Cu-rich mid composition (idx 71: Cu0.46 Fe0.14 V0.39 → 4.6 µA), and a more V-rich, Cu-poorer neighbour (idx 18: Cu0.08 Fe0.10 V0.82 → 8.6 µA). Idx 19 is the highest measured. The results suggest an optimum near Cu≈Fe≈0.10 in the V-rich corner.

rejected.reason: Cu-rich mid-ternary composition, measured 4.6 µA, about 3x lower than idx 19
Pushing toward more V and less Cu lowered the photocurrent to 8.6 µA
GP suggestion; its predicted mean (6.4 µA) was below the measured best, and there was no budget left to test it
